BTC: 97k (+3%), ETH: 1840 (+2%), SOL: 147 (+2%). Top Gainers: LTC, STX, WLD, FET, QNT. BTC ETFs: -$86mn, ETH ETFs: -$18mn. Crypto rallies on US-China trade talk news. BTC dominance breaks through 65%. New Hampshire first state to setup crypto reserve. UK treasury rules out BTC reserve. Thumzup to sell $500m stock to buy BTC. SOL Strategies buys $18.25m SOL. Citi, SDX plan to tokenise pre-IPO market. Global stablecoin supply up 14% in 2025. Tether to deploy USDT on Kaia. WLFI to airdrop stablecoin on ETH mainnet. AI will buy BTC: Saylor. Bitwise files for NEAR ETF. Strike launches BTC backed lending. Armstrong’s startup valued at $810m. CZ applies for pardon in US. Bhutan launches crypto payments for tourists. We don’t want Fed to issue CBDC: Bessent.

entry.summary:

Florida’s BTC reserve bills postponed. Semler Scientific buys $16m BTC. Riot Platforms sold $39m BTC in April. BTC coinbase premium dropping again. DeFi Development buys $72m SOL. SOL April revenue is more than all L1, L2 chains. SUI stablecoin supply $900m, sets new ATH. SEC delays Canary LTC ETF. CFTC to observe pilot tokenisation programs.
